text:
elena: Heads up — yesterday's telemetry backfill for cohort A blew past the tenant quota and tripped the canary fallback; some dashboards showed stale agg counts for ~45m.

owen: ugh. do we have the job id? was it the big rehydrate or a targeted recompute?

elena: job id rbh-2026-03-18-17. targeted recompute for user cohorts, ~2.1B events estimated. it started without a quota precheck.

raj: was quota exhaustion on Dedicated pools or hosted?

elena: Dedicated pool (eu-west-1), slice capacity hit — autoscaler didn't kick in fast enough because of a throttle guard.

marta: customers saw missing aggregates in Console right? any alert noise?

elena: yes, Console showed "stale data" cards flickering. Support had a couple tickets. we got a 3am page.

ajamal: we should add a quick UX nudge in the Console when someone schedules a large reprocess — show estimated token/compute and warn if it might saturate tenant quota. simple, low risk. :thumbsup:

owen: agreed. we already have the backend to estimate job footprint (the replayer returns an "estimated_units" field). just need a preflight API + small UI.

andre: small API design debate: add a POST /v1/telemetry/preflight-estimate that takes a query & window and returns {estimated_units, peak_rps, expected_duration}. or reuse the existing /jobs/estimate? pros/cons?

raj: prefer separate endpoint. preflight should be idempotent and cheap. reuse would couple job submission path with UI queries. also easier to rate-limit.

marta: from Product side, the Console should show two things: (1) estimated cost + capacity impact, (2) recommended safety options (canary %, preemptible, throttle). also a one-click "open support/enterprise" link if they need quota bump.

jamal: mock UX copy suggestion: "This recompute will process ~2.1B events (~48 compute-units). It may exceed your Dedicated quota and trigger fallbacks; we recommend running a 10% canary first or using the \"preflight\" dry-run."

elena: technical ask: can preflight also return a short plan of how jobs will be routed (e.g., dedicated->burst->hosted fallback) so console can show likely fallback path?

raj: yes we can return a "routing_prediction" array with labels like ["dedicated", "burst_spot", "hosted_fallback"], but keep it advisory only.

owen: implement notes: 1) endpoint with a 30s compute budget, 2) reuse the sampler used by the replayer to approximate cost, 3) cache estimates for same query signature for 10m.

andre: security/permissions: preflight should require same auth scope as create-job to avoid info leaks about tenant capacity.

marta: timeline — can we get a POC in 2 weeks? small Console banner + modal.

jamal: i'll take the modal copy + tiny mock. will also add the "run 10% canary" quick-toggles.

raj: ops follow-up — add a circuit-breaker that prevents jobs from auto-escalating to hosted fallback if the tenant has "no-fallback" flag set. we hit that case yesterday and it caused silent fails.

elena: noted. i'll file follow-ups: (1) API spec, (2) Console modal mock, (3) ops circuit-breaker playbook.

console-bot: ACTIONS CREATED: #1234 preflight-api-spec, #1235 console-preflight-modal, #1236 ops-circuit-breaker.

nowen: quick example preflight call for the spec:
```bash
curl -X POST 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/telemetry/preflight-estimate 
  -d '{"query":"event_type:user_action","start":"2026-02-01","end":"2026-02-28","cohort":"A"}'
```

andre: sample response (annotative):
```json
{
  "estimated_units": 48000,            // compute-units (internal), string? integs ok
  "peak_rps": 1200,
  "expected_duration": 7200,          // seconds
  "routing_prediction": ["dedicated","burst_spot","hosted_fallback"]
}
```

raj: ops check command to find running backfills:
```bash
psql -c "select job_id,status,tenant,estimated_units from telemetry_jobs where status in ('running','queued') order by created_at desc limit 20;" telemetry_db
```

marta: +1 on the UX nudge. also can we add a small quota-meter in the Job modal that shows "current usage / quota" with color states (green/yellow/red)?

elena: yes — Console team will wire that into the modal once preflight returns estimated_units.

owen: any objections to adding a soft-block when estimated_units > tenant.quota * 0.9? soft-block = interrupt with a modal "This will likely exceed your quota. Continue?"

marta: sounds good. product prefers soft-block + recommended mitigations rather than hard block.

elena: ok i'll draft the API PR and the ticket list. thanks all.

console-bot: REMINDER: weekly infra sync Thu 10:00 to review preflight progress.
